questions.q: What two ingredients did Arianna originally think defined success?
questions.why: The text says she thought success consisted of money and power.

questions.q: What event prompted Arianna to reconsider her view of success?
questions.why: She fainted in her office in 2007, leading to the wake‑up call.

questions.q: According to Huffington, where does true wisdom reside?
questions.why: She claims true wisdom lives inside every single one of us.

questions.q: Approximately how many times per day does the average person check their smartphone?
questions.why: The book cites an average of 150 smartphone checks per day.

questions.q: What third metric does Huffington suggest adding to success?
questions.why: She adds thriving as a third metric to measure fulfillment.
